
```{r}
# calculate the area of the grid cells
grid_2km <- grid.2km %>%
  mutate(cell_area = st_area(.))

# fit the grid and calculate piece sizes
ALCO.grid <- sf::st_intersection(ALCO, grid_2km) %>%
  mutate(intersect_area = sf::st_area(.))

# calculate the area-weighted average
alco_weighted <- ALCO.grid %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(
    intersect_area_num = as.numeric(intersect_area),
    cell_area_num = as.numeric(cell_area),

    # calculate the percentage of the cell this specific piece covers
    area_weight = intersect_area_num / cell_area_num,

    # multiply the continuous value by its weight
    weighted_score = ALCO_RI * area_weight
  ) %>%
  group_by(CellID_2km) %>%
  # sum all the weighted pieces together for the final cell score
  summarize(
    Score.ALCO = sum(weighted_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# rejoin to the spatial grid
alco_scored <- grid_2km %>%
  inner_join(alco_weighted, by = "CellID_2km")
```
